mapper.select: SELECT USER_PASSWORD_HASH FROM `USER` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.USER_NICKNAME, ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL, u.USER_NAME, u.USER_PHONE_NUMBER, u.USER_EMAIL, ep.BIRTH_DATE FROM USER u JOIN USER_BUTTIE ub ON u.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET USER_NICKNAME = #{user.userNickname}, USER_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{user.userId}
